content:
Madonna made a spectacular appearance at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, 23 years after she last headlined the opening performance of the ceremony.

The 68-year-old singer of "Confessions II" has now set a record by performing the VMA opening five times.

During her Sunday night performance, the singer invited Charli xcx, Sabrina Carpenter, Sombr and her long-time friend Debi Mazar on stage. Madonna also brought out Andrew Watt, Seth Rogen (yes, you read that right!) and Julia Garner, who was set to portray the pop icon in a now-scrapped Madonna biopic.

Fans on X were stunned seeing some of the guests appear, especially Rogen, and could hardly believe their eyes:

Madonna's most memorable opening performance came in 2003, when she appeared alongside Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera.

Madonna received a leading 11 nominations at this year's VMAs, including Artist of the Year, Song of the Year and Video of the Year.

Taylor Swift followed closely behind with nine nominations, including one for the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors award.

In a press release, MTV described the award as "a brand-new honor recognizing the groundbreaking musicians who unleash creativity behind the camera, push the boundaries of what music videos can be and advance the art of visual storytelling."
